title: Two Runs Out of Nenana

roles.sky: #F2A779 apricot civil-twilight band low on the horizon, rising through dusky mauve #8A6283 to plum night #3B2B4A at the top of frame; never cyan, teal or cobalt
roles.ground: #D9D0E3 lavender snow and river ice, shade #A79BB8, a warm peach catch #F6D9C4 where the twilight hits; spruce black #1F2621 treelines and ink
roles.hero: #C8E3F0 frosted glass sample tubes with an oxblood fill #7E1626 and a cream cap #F3EBDD, full ink outline and a #20182B contact shadow; staged ONLY against plum falloff, the dusk sky, the crate interior or the fridge glow, never on open snow (glass and lavender ice share a value); FLEW's frost rim is on the outer glass only, never ice in the fill, because frozen blood would read as degraded
roles.ribbon: #E0303F scarlet, ONLY the throughline ribbon and its loop; nothing else in the film is scarlet
roles.accent: #2EE86B radar-phosphor green on dark or dusk grounds and #13A84A on snow or map, every dash with a 3 px #20182B plum-ink keyline, ONLY what is PLANNED or seen by a machine: the dashed radar, its dashes, the sight bubble's edge (Gate 0D: mint #5FE0C2 had no value contrast on lavender snow and sat in the last two films' cool family and 11-18's mint)
roles.sepia: #B98A57 ONLY 1925 (the dog team, mushers, the train and the paw trail ink), so the past always reads as the past
roles.map: the giant map is cream paper #F1E6D2 laid on the lavender ice, its land a faded sage #B9C3A2 with sepia rivers, water a pale mauve-grey #BDB3C8
roles.aircraft: #9A96A0 quiet grey CargoDrone with an apricot rim, staged in silhouette against the apricot band #F2A779, never against mauve

palette.mood: a long Interior dusk on the river ice at Nenana: cold air, warm low light, a quiet place where two journeys started a century apart
palette.why: Apricot and plum because an Alaska winter dusk is the hour of this story (the 1925 relay ran in January dark), and it diverges hard from 11-22's cyan-grey and teal lab and 11-21's birch, walnut and mustard. Scarlet belongs to the ribbon alone so the throughline is the most saturated thing in every frame. Mint means machine sight and PLANNED, so the radar can never be mistaken for installed hardware. Sepia means 1925, so the two runs never blur. Blood is oxblood, a darker red than the ribbon, so the ribbon never reads as blood. Phosphor green replaces mint for machine sight (Gate 0D).

light.map_on_ice: key: the low apricot sun from frame left, raking long shadows of pins, the dog team and the drone's shadow across the cream map; fill: cool lavender bounce off the ice; rim: apricot on every upright.
light.runway_depot: key: apricot from the low sun behind the depot, the ULTRA in near silhouette with an apricot rim on the wing; fill: runway edge lights and a hangar door spill.
light.ground_station: interior key: the console's soft white screen glow on the faceless pilot; fill: a window behind showing the dusk runway; rim: apricot through the window.
light.test_table: key: a hanging work lamp straight down onto the tubes and the face-down card; the room falls off to plum; the card's back is the brightest paper in frame.
light.village: key: apricot horizon behind the roofs, warm yellow clinic window light as the focal glow; fill: lavender snow bounce.
light.depth: three planes everywhere: the near ice or snow drifts and a fence in the lower third, the subject plane, and the far spruce line and Alaska Range silhouette under the dusk sky, with parallax on every camera move.
light.1925: a flat sepia-graded key with a vignette and paper grain, no rim, so 1925 reads as an old print
light.turn: the Turn plays on the map on the ice: the ribbon reaches from NENANA toward the village roofs and snags on the phosphor edge of the sight bubble drawn on the map around the ground station's town

shape_language: LINE vs LOOP: the 1925 run, the rail, the runway and the trail are long straight lines; the drone's flight, the ribbon's closed loop, the sight bubble and the radar sweep are circles. Living things (tubes, dogs, the moose) are round and soft. The thesis is a loop that has the length of the line and hasn't been allowed to become one. The moose is cut (Gate 0D: 11-21 used it as its Alaska cue); the dog team, the raven and the Tanana carry Alaska.

casting.hero: FLEW and STAYED, a NET-NEW reusable library pair (lib/serum.tsx `SampleTube`): frosted glass sample tubes with cream caps, oxblood fill, eyes and a mouth on the glass, moods (eager, nervous, frosty, calm, wistful), goggles, a frost rim, tags. Gap: the shelf has no small faced container that can be a blood sample; FlightCrate is a crate, and the pair carries the two-sample comparison the claims make.
casting.ai_presence: RADAR, NET-NEW (lib/serum.tsx `RadarEye`): a small dish with one eye, drawn ENTIRELY in phosphor-green dashes with plum keylines and a PLANNED tag plate in every frame it appears, never solid, never mounted on or settling on the aircraft. It is absent from the whole August 19th sequence (the only thing seeing then is the faceless pilot inside the sight bubble); it enters at the Turn, passes through the wing dashed and keeps moving, and keeps its dashes and PLANNED tag in the button.
casting.aircraft: NET-NEW (lib/serum.tsx `CargoDrone`): a plain, accurate twin-engine high-wing cargo drone, #9A96A0 grey with an apricot rim, 31 ft scale. NO eyes, NO mouth, NO cheek decals. It is a company's product and stays a machine.
casting.supporting_shelf: SledDogTeam (fauna.tsx) for the 1925 relay drawn sepia with faceless mushers in plain generic parkas (no patterned trim, no kuspuk, no carved or beadwork motifs); FlightCrate (clinic.tsx) as FLEW's ride; Suit (lib/people.tsx, face={false}) for a faceless Cathy Cahill and the faceless pilot with boxed name tags; AK_PATH (lib/akmap.ts) for the map on the ice; Raven (fauna.tsx) circling the loop; Drone (polecam.tsx) for small drones.
casting.net_new_support: lib/serum.tsx also gets `Ribbon` (the scarlet throughline, a polyline that morphs loop to line, last stretch can dash), `SightBubble` (a phosphor-edged dome), `ResultTray` (a small lab results printer whose output tray stays empty under the work lamp, a LAB RESULTS · NOT PUBLISHED plate; replaces a face-down card, which Gate 0D called a three-film idiom), `GroundStation` (console, screens, mug), `Village` (roofs, a clinic with a warm window and a short runway; no totems, regalia, patterned textiles or Native symbols; TCC appears only as a text plate), `SampleFridge`, `Train1925` and `Engine1925`. Shelf gap proof (grep of ASSET_INDEX.md for village, clinic building, printer, console, fridge, cargo drone, radar dish): only FlightCrate, the clinic family's TypeSlug, FieldRadiograph and AllowanceBoard, polecam's small Drone and evidence_state's SeedDrone exist; none is a village, a ground station, a printer, a fridge, a fixed-wing cargo drone or a radar dish.
casting.small_drone: Shelf `Drone` (lib/polecam.tsx), a small quadcopter, for c26 SMALL DRONES FLOWN AT 40 BELOW · PER CAHILL; the CargoDrone is never used for that beat.

motion_language: The dogs gallop and the line draws forward; the drone glides and the ribbon curls. The tubes react in squash and quick blinks; the card rattles but never lifts; the radar's dashes march but never join. The ribbon pulls taut with a twang and snaps back with an overshoot. 180-degree blur on the ribbon snap and the drone pass; anticipation before every stamp.

composition.focal_hierarchy: the ribbon is always the most saturated thing; the tubes or the drone are the subject; plates sit at y 560 to 760 in the overlay band
composition.negative_space: the empty Nenana runway with one edge light after the drone lands, and the bare cream map after the ribbon snaps home
composition.safe_area: hero action and plates inside y 420 to 1500; tubes, dogs and the drone never below y 1300; the lower band is ice drifts, the runway fence or the console edge
composition.signature_shot: Two scales on the map on the ice. Wide: the scarlet ribbon (at least 14 px) pulled taut lies beside the sepia paw trail (at least 10 px), plates 1,000 KM LOOP · LAID STRAIGHT and NENANA TO NOME · 674 MILES, then ABOUT 621 MILES; it reads as a comparison, never a delivery. Push in on the ribbon's frayed end short of Nome: the lead dog sniffs it, then the ribbon twangs back into a loop on NENANA. No derived 'miles short' figure is printed.

craft_advance: One reusable family, lib/serum.tsx, registered in ASSET_MANIFEST.md; no engine system advanced.
treatment: Two Runs Out of Nenana (Dramatist winner, grafted with the Comedian's moose and string gag and the Explainer's sight bubble). A giant Alaska map on the frozen Tanana at dusk: a sepia dog team inks a paw trail toward Nome while a drone's shadow closes a scarlet loop back on NENANA. 1925 (diphtheria, train to Nenana, 20 mushers, 674 miles, a small engine at 40 below). August 19th at the Nenana runway: the plain ULTRA, a faceless pilot at a ground station inside a sight bubble, FLEW and STAYED split between the crate and a fridge, 8 HR 47 MIN, the ribbon pulled straight beside the trail. The Test at a lamp-lit table: two tubes, Cahill's quote, a face-down card that won't flip, NOT TESTED FOR DOPING, SMALL DRONES. The Turn: the ribbon reaches for a village and snags on the sight bubble; a dashed radar passes through the wing like a ghost. The button: the ribbon across the map toward the clinic, last stretch dashed PLANNED.
